description: Multifunction energy meter: per-phase values, four-quadrant energy, pulse, temperature and analog inputs, digital and analog outputs, Modbus RTU, TCP and UDP
notes: Functions 03 and 04 read the same registers; 06 and 16 write; 43 reads the device identification.

Modbus RTU is enabled in the settings menu, with 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity and a selectable speed; the manual gives no factory speed or address (9600 bit/s and address 1 assumed). Address 254 is answered by every meter.
Modbus TCP and UDP use port 502 and ignore the unit identifier; at most 2 TCP connections.
Multi-register values have the high word first.
Registers 20000 to 29999 repeat the float registers as 16-bit integers multiplied by 10 (add 20000 to the address); they are not listed.
The alarm word is at registers 100 and 101; the bits listed are all in register 101.
Days of a schedule: bit 7 is Sunday down to bit 1 Saturday, bit 0 holidays.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
